description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for the 'git patch-id' command. It sets up various repository states, runs commands like 'git log', 'git patch-id', 'git format-patch', and compares outputs to verify the behavior of patch ID calculation under different scenarios. The script also manages configuration setups, compares results, and includes failure and cleanup conditions—that collectively demonstrate comprehensive testing of Git's patch ID feature.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff from the latest commit in the specified branch or reference.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff and calculates its patch ID, representing the current head state.

methods.name: cmp_patch_id
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs for equality or inequality depending on the specified relevance.

methods.name: test_patch_id
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive test of patch ID calculations with various options and scenarios.
